Latitude.note: The draft air permit from the North Dakota Department of Environmental Quality, https://deq.nd.gov/AQ/Notices/AppliedDigital/DRAFT_ACP18338v1_0.pdf, gives the ELN Generation Plant address as 9663 87th Ave. SE, Ellendale. The department's site record for that address, Applied Digital Corporation ELN Building 1 GEN Plant, https://ceris.deq.nd.gov/ext/nsite/DEFAULT/map/results/detail/-8841860088109998100/detail, holds both air permits for the engines, ACP-18296 and ACP-18338. The department's site map service places that record at 46.014383, -98.574269. That page is drawn by a script, so I read the point from the map service the page calls. OpenStreetMap maps the campus as Applied Digital / Ellendale Data Center, https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/1422191450, and the department's point falls inside that outline. The new point is 46.01438, -98.57427, about 820 meters south of the database point. So the plant is exact, by coordinates a government body published, backed by the OpenStreetMap outline. Satellite imagery of unknown date shows the existing data halls just south of the point and a new building under construction just east of it.

location.location_route: The North Dakota Department of Environmental Quality publishes a point for the permitted generator plant site, and it falls inside the OpenStreetMap outline of the Applied Digital Ellendale campus.

qa.question: Should the Ellendale engine plant move to the point the air quality division publishes for it?
qa.finding: The air quality division's site record for the permitted generator plant, at 9663 87th Ave. SE, sits at 46.01438, -98.57427. The database point, 46.02178, -98.57360, is about 76 meters from a separate stormwater construction record named Applied Digital ELN-03, which the department places at 46.0211, -98.573731.
qa.recommendation: Move the plant point to 46.01438, -98.57427 and mark it exact, since both engine air permits sit on that site record.
qa.note: The first look used the street address geocoded to 46.01096, -98.56866. That point sits on the road at the southeast corner of the campus, about 450 meters from the department's point. The ELN-03 record covers a construction stormwater permit, NDR113237, and no air permit, so the database point may mark the ELN03 engine building site rather than the generator plant record. The site record page is https://ceris.deq.nd.gov/ext/nsite/DEFAULT/map/results/detail/-8841860088109998100/detail. It is drawn by a script, so the coordinates were read from the department's map search service and could not be checked by text match on the page. Imagery of the database point shows farmland, but the imagery date is unknown and may be older than construction.
